What we do

Six ways we clear the path.

Talent is spread evenly across villages. Opportunity is not. Each programme removes one barrier between a capable student and the future they've earned.

Talent tests

The Srinivasa Ramanujan Talent Test finds bright Class 9 & 10 students in government schools — and rewards what others overlook.

Scholarships

Direct financial help keeps a student in school through a family's hardest year. Over 400 supported so far.

Digital access

More than 180 laptops placed in the hands of students who had never owned one — turning a distant course into a daily habit.

Mentorship

Weekend sessions with leaders, officers and professionals — 50 and counting — show students what their effort can become.

Government-exam prep

Our DSC (SGT) Grand Test and mock exams prepare aspirants for teaching and police jobs — 30+ into secure government roles.

School adoption

We upgrade whole government schools with digital learning tools, so the change outlasts any single class.

The flagship

The Srinivasa Ramanujan Talent Test.

Once a year, thousands of government-school students across Anantapur and Sri Sathya Sai districts sit a single exam — and the ones who shine are recognised, rewarded and remembered. In 2022 alone, 4,200 students wrote it across six centres in one Sunday.

We've now published five years of papers — 500 questions, free for every student preparing for what comes next.

2021–2025 papers 500 questions Bilingual · English & Telugu Free for students
